**Stream Clipper v1.3.1: clip GTA 6 streams into Shorts and TikToks.** Works for any streamer, game or language.

**⬇ Windows: download `StreamClipper-Setup.exe` and run it: Next → Next → Install.** No admin needed.

- **Fixed: wrong game everywhere.** Titles, descriptions and hashtags now use the real game of the stream (Twitch / Kick / YouTube category, official name via Steam, e.g. `#CS2`, `#CallOfDuty`, `#TheFinals`). Unknown game = neutral `#gaming #clips`, never GTA 6. You can set the game per clip.
- **Fixed: on-video text.** Burned-in captions are only the words the streamer says. No game name or generic hook text on the video any more.
- **Twitch and Kick** links: more reliable live recording (reconnects, right headers, quality limit) and game detection.
- In-app updates (1.3.0+): the Update button and the check on every launch work.
- Multiple TikTok / YouTube Shorts accounts, desktop UI, General settings (CPU/GPU, resets).

Unofficial fan tool, not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two. Built by a beginner with AI-assisted coding; limits are in the README.
